// Package dbtype stands in for the driver's dbtype package so the
// emitted decoders can be run rather than only read. Every declaration
// here is copied from
// neo4j-go-driver/v5@v5.28.4/neo4j/dbtype/{graph,temporal,spatial}.go.
//
// Fidelity is not left to this copy alone: `just test-codegen-fence`
// compiles the same emitted shapes against the real driver, so a drift
// that mattered to compilation is caught there. What this stub buys is
// behaviour — what a decoder does with the values a driver puts in the
// Props map, which no amount of compiling can show.
package dbtype

import "time"

type Entity interface {
	GetId() int64
	GetElementId() string
	GetProperties() map[string]any
}

type Node struct {
	Id        int64
	ElementId string
	Labels    []string
	Props     map[string]any
}

func (n Node) GetId() int64 { return n.Id }

func (n Node) GetElementId() string { return n.ElementId }

func (n Node) GetProperties() map[string]any { return n.Props }

type Relationship struct {
	Id             int64
	ElementId      string
	StartId        int64
	StartElementId string
	EndId          int64
	EndElementId   string
	Type           string
	Props          map[string]any
}

func (r Relationship) GetId() int64 { return r.Id }

func (r Relationship) GetElementId() string { return r.ElementId }

func (r Relationship) GetProperties() map[string]any { return r.Props }

type Path struct {
	Nodes         []Node
	Relationships []Relationship
}

type (
	Time          time.Time
	Date          time.Time
	LocalTime     time.Time
	LocalDateTime time.Time
)

type Duration struct {
	Months  int64
	Days    int64
	Seconds int64
	Nanos   int
}

type Point2D struct {
	X            float64
	Y            float64
	SpatialRefId uint32
}

type Point3D struct {
	X            float64
	Y            float64
	Z            float64
	SpatialRefId uint32
}
